When asked about an INT thrown today during practice, Aaron Rodgers said Roman Wilson made a 'repeat mistake' from earlier in training, but that he is 'proud' of the third-year WR who has had a strong training camp:

"Roman made a repeat mistake. That's a good learning experience, because I don't think he's going to do that again. But he did the same thing early in training camp, and we said, 'hey, on that under route, you've got to keep coming.' So I think it's best that it happened in practice. Roman is a great kid. He's had a fantastic camp. I have utmost confidence in him. He's going to have to play a big role for us. But mistakes can happen. That's a great one to happen in practice. But he's gotten a lot better, and I'm really proud of Roman."

For all they do, they’ve had one SB win in 10 years.

quoted.text:
Do you want the facts about the Rams?

• 2025: Blew 2H leads of 19 (PHI) and 16 (SEA)
• 2025: Lost 3 games as a favorite of 7.5-10 PTS
• McVay has won 1 ring in 9 seasons
• 2021: Traded for Stafford/Von/Michel, signed Beckham in Nov.
• Only SB winner to face teams in CCG and SB who didn't win 60% of their reg. season games (two 10-7 teams)
• Only SB winner to play the SB in home stadium with a full crowd (2020 TB was COVID)
• Even against weaker competition, only team to win 3 straight PO games by 1-3 points in NFL history
• That started after they blew a 27-3 lead in TB with a ton of miscues 
• 2018: McVay got to his 1st SB thanks to the worst no call for DPI in NFL history in NOLA that led to PI being challengeable in 2019
• Scored 3 points in the SB vs. NE
• 2019: Missed POs after ranking 6th in preseason SB odds (+1400)
• 2020: The only top 10 defense of McVay's career lit up for 32 in loss at GB
• 2022: Worst SB title defense (5-12) in NFL history.
• 2023: Started 3-6 before beating up on mostly non-PO teams; lost WC in Detroit to Goff 
• 2024: Slow start (1-4) again, won division on 2nd tiebreaker, good effort in Philly loss
• 2025: Gave up 5 GWDs in the regular season; gave up late TD drives to Young and Caleb (a 14-yard Hail Mary TD from the 40) before winning both games, scoreless 4Q in Seattle, made Darnold look like a HOFer

Those are the facts. Given that, here's my opinion: The Rams have gotten more aggressive in their team building strategy that did produce one SB win, but it's a volatile strategy since you're buying premium goods and hoping they fit and that you'll keep finding mid-round successes like Kupp, Young, Puka, Kyren, etc.

They are not a blueprint for the rest of the NFL to follow. They are basically higher stake gamblers who really try to go all in during years they happen to be hosting the Super Bowl (2021, 2026).

But their on-field product isn't any better or more sustainable than what teams like the Chiefs and Eagles have built since 2017. We'll see on Seattle too after it only took 2 years for Macdonald to get the defense to elite status and win a SB with Darnold.

But the Rams absolutely do not win enough to act like this team's strategy is the optimal way to do business in the NFL.

quoted.text:
Much has been made of the Patriots’ mysterious “Pink Stripes.” How about yellow ones?

I went through more than a decade of TV broadcasts and uncovered a diabolically clever piece of Patriots gamesmanship.

When opposing kickers lined up at Gillette Stadium, the video board displayed a reverse view of the kick, placing a second, offset set of yellow uprights directly behind the real ones.

In windy conditions, even the orange streamers on the video board appeared to point in the opposite direction from those atop the physical uprights, making the illusion even more disorienting.

I found dozens of examples. In the same games, I reviewed 52 Patriots field goal attempts.

The illusion appeared on Patriots kicks exactly zero times.

We actually tried copying the idea when I was in Philadelphia, but the location of the video boards at Lincoln Financial Field made it nearly useless.

It is the perfect encapsulation of the Patriots dynasty. No detail was too small, and no possible edge was left unexplored.

We talked about this tactic and more on tonight’s episode of the Paganetti and Underhill show, out now on Youtube
